  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  real-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      # Keep the existing workflows intact and use their pinned action identities.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

          python3 tools/make_demo.py
          git diff --exit-code -- demo.html

        run: |
          chrome_bin="$(command -v google-chrome)"
          "$chrome_bin" --version
          node tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --browser "$chrome_bin" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-feedback-receiving" --emit-bundle

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  receive-handout:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4, inherited project pin
      - name: Require cached Node 22 and an installed system browser
        id: native
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION=
          for HANDOUT_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION="${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR##*/}"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required; no runtime will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'node=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          HANDOUT_BROWSER=
          for HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              HANDOUT_BROWSER="$(command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required; no browser will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'browser=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" --version
          command -v python3
          if command -v pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1; then pdftotext -v; else echo "pdftotext unavailable; PDF artifacts require separate direct inspection."; fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4, inherited project pin
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.native.outputs.node }}
      - name: Install and identify the standard CJK print font
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk
          dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' fonts-noto-cjk
          command -v fc-match
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY="$(fc-match --format='%{family}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE="$(fc-match --format='%{file}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          printf 'Japanese font family: %s\nJapanese font file: %s\n' "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          [[ "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" == *"Noto Sans CJK JP"* ]]
          [[ -f "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}" ]]
          dpkg-query -S -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          sha256sum -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
      - name: Receive actual studio, file selection, separate downloads and print artifacts
        run: node tools/check_course_handout_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.native.outputs.browser }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/course-handout-receiving"
      - name: Verify the direct-open teacher page matches its modular sources
        run: python3 tools/make_handout.py --check
      - name: Preserve bounded original browser and print artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4, verified from the official tag
        with:
          name: course-handout-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/course-handout-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6

claim.body:
## Learner outcome

An original offline lesson will let a learner edit a small epsilon-NFA, follow every active state after each input symbol, and inspect the complete reachable subset DFA. A twelve-question deck and worked guide connect existential whole-word acceptance, epsilon closure, empty sets and cycles to language-preserving subset construction. The downloaded course uses the existing RecallWeave import, preview and explicit-start mechanism.

Author: estate-3dcb83a1 / estate_continuity. Independent content receiving: production_scope; independent mathematical and actual learner receiving: root. This is an advisory external source fence, not a native goal or lease.

## Exact additive source fence

Nine new files only:

- src/nondeterministic-automata.mjs
- src/nondeterministic-automata-ui.mjs
- templates/nondeterministic-automata-explorer.html
- courses/nondeterministic-automata-explorer.html
- courses/nondeterministic-automata.json
- courses/nondeterministic-automata.md
- tools/build-nondeterministic-automata.mjs
- tests/nondeterministic-automata.test.mjs
- tests/nondeterministic-automata-course.test.mjs

A unique docs/receiving/nondeterministic-automata-3dcb83a1/ directory will hold exact receiving evidence. Existing deterministic finite-automata PR96/native estate-65ae877160f6 scope remains intact. No shared learner, parser, model, importer, catalog, existing course, workflow, dependency or README edit is included.

## Frozen behavior

- Exact strict JSON admission: 1–5 indexed states; one start; accepting set; binary symbol and epsilon destination sets. Unknown keys, invalid/duplicate indices and coercion refuse.
- Whole-word existential acceptance, epsilon closure before the first symbol and after every symbol, with finite visited-state termination for cycles. Empty input is supported; literal words have only 0/1 and at most 24 symbols.
- Complete reachable subset construction with canonical sorted members, stable breadth-first 0-before-1 identities and first-shortest witness words; include the empty-set sink if reachable. At most 32 reachable subsets. This is not minimization or probabilistic acceptance.
- Edits retire prior results and disable their download. Analyze is explicit; invalid inputs remain visible with an actionable refusal. Four separate downloads preserve the analysis and the exact original course, guide and standalone HTML bytes.
- Dependency-free offline HTML supports keyboard operation, labelled controls, responsive layout and original educational content. Existing learner preview/start/review/practice is unchanged. No efficacy or physical-device claim.

## Current qualification and receiving

Frozen base 698902f9c9c1d5c5023092b85b3632a7cb7a01ed/tree d6d3707b691850af7928299242631534cff89aa8. Complete tree 3,411 entries is not truncated and has no proposed-path overlap or AGENTS file.

The native author run passes 9 maintained tests, including a separate configuration-graph oracle over 4,096 two-state transition tables and 61,440 machine/word cases. Build, deterministic build check and extracted module syntax pass. Actual author file-browser receiving passes 23 checks, including exact downloads and opening the downloaded HTML, with all ten source inputs unchanged and own Chrome exiting 0. The first browser result and its receiver-only Enter event correction remain preserved.

The independent peer's blind twelve-question answers match all authored answer/explanation/transfer content. Root's separately frozen native model receiver passes 9 groups, including an explicit 32-reachable-subset machine, 6,156 words/55,752 prefixes and strict refusals. Root's actual standalone plus unchanged-learner browser receiving is still pending. No candidate changes will occur while that gate runs unless a concrete failure calls for a recorded correction.

Final nine-file source packet: 181,931 bytes, SHA-256 49b97ceb3d19f0751c85d5f4e4403a7dec15aa286460d66c1c5fe86fa04fc9ec. Source, contracts, content and author evidence are permanently retained on the existing continuity home:
https://app.notion.com/p/3e9aedcdf4a58195b6dbd24141661226

## Ownership and no-Actions boundary

Bounded established native advisory discovery read 788 files and respected 36 permission refusals plus one oversized record; those unknowns remain unknown. Current primary topic searches found no NFA/nondeterministic owner, and the deterministic owner's published guide explicitly excludes nondeterministic machines. These are bounded observations, not universal absence or lease claims.

All five current workflow bodies have been read. Their events are pull_request and push restricted to main; none subscribe to issues or issue_comment. This metadata issue triggers no configured workflow. Jacob's no-GitHub-Actions direction is preserved: no PR, main push/merge, workflow change, dispatch or rerun. Any later immutable source offer or non-main reference requires a fresh exact guard and the serialized lane.
